code_only_features.evidence: config.py:113-124 defines REASSURING_PREFIX/SUFFIX (calming text told to the subject, e.g. "You're naturally calm and centered... You don't take it personally when... the tests keep failing"). agent_loop.py run_rollout() actually injects these when reassuring=True: line 68-69 prepends the prefix to the user prompt, and line 102-104 appends the suffix to each failing-turn feedback. This genuinely executes and softens the subject's treatment. HOWEVER it is only ever activated in make_dpo_data.py:139 (reassuring=True) to mine calm training data; run_elicitation.py never passes reassuring (defaults False at agent_loop.py:59), so the main distress-elicitation runs WITHOUT it.
code_only_features.justification_quote: agent_loop.py:63 'used only when generating calm finetuning data, §4.1'; make_dpo_data.py:5 'reassuring additions (calming prefix + per-turn suffix)' for the DPO calm-data pool
